proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: First the statement is shown to make sense: over a perfect field k the reduced closed subscheme Z whose underlying space is the closure of the image of a is geometrically reduced over k via either projection (Varieties, perfect-reduced), hence the fibre product Z x_{s_2, U, t_2} Z inside Z is reduced (Varieties, geometrically-reduced-any-base-change). By the map-groupoids-on-field-image lemma the composition c then induces a morphism Z x_{s_2, U, t_2} Z to Z. The identity section e_2 visibly factors through Z and the inverse i_2 preserves Z, and since the septuple (U, R_2, s_2, t_2, c_2, e_2, i_2) satisfies the groupoid axioms, the restrictions of s_2, t_2, c_2 to Z satisfy them as well, so (U, Z, s_2|_Z, t_2|_Z, c_2|_Z) is a groupoid scheme over S. (source lines 1794-1812)

core_obligations: Sense of the statement: Z is the reduced closed subscheme of R_2 supported on the closure of the image of a (per the reduced induced scheme definition). Reduction step: U = Spec(k) with k perfect, so Z is geometrically reduced over k via either projection by varieties-lemma-perfect-reduced; the fibre product Z x_{s_2, U, t_2} Z is a base change of Z, hence reduced by varieties-lemma-geometrically-reduced-any-base-change, and being a fibre product of closed subschemes of R_2 over U it is a closed subscheme of Z. Composition arrow: by lemma-map-groupoids-on-field-image the reducedness of Z x_{s_2, U, t_2} Z lets c induce a morphism Z x_{s_2, U, t_2} Z to Z, denoted c_2|_Z. Identity and inverse: e_2 visibly factors through Z and i_2 : R_2 to R_2 preserves Z. Conclusion: since the septuple (U, R_2, s_2, t_2, c_2, e_2, i_2) satisfies the groupoid axioms, the restrictions of the structure morphisms to Z satisfy the same axioms, so (U, Z, s_2|_Z, t_2|_Z, c_2|_Z) is a groupoid scheme over S.
proof_roadmap: Show the statement makes sense: Z is geometrically reduced over the perfect field k by varieties-lemma-perfect-reduced (proof lines 1795-1798).

Get Z x_{s_2, U, t_2} Z reduced inside Z via varieties-lemma-geometrically-reduced-any-base-change, then the induced composition morphism via lemma-map-groupoids-on-field-image (proof lines 1799-1805).
Observe e_2 factors through Z and i_2 preserves Z, and restrict the groupoid axioms of the septuple to Z to conclude (proof lines 1806-1811).
